invariants.rationale: Timestamps or instant identifiers are typically expected to be non-null for write commit operations.
The method expects a list of records to upsert, which should not be null.
Target file group IDs are expected for the update operation, so the list should not be null.
A valid BaseHoodieWriteClient is necessary to perform the operations this method is supposed to implement.
If the record input list is empty, its size is zero or more; this checks realistic collection size.
